<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>RBI Policy and Inflation:</strong> The RBI has kept the repo rate unchanged and projects a 6.9% real GDP growth for the current fiscal, even as rising inflation to 4.38% in June complicates the central bank&#x27;s future monetary policy path.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxOTGFSNzg0VzlJdnMwYWh2TzliX3libXhnd0pFajdsbW05R3dZU3Y5V3BjRU5uV2Q0aDVOZWZNX3dDdHpvNXpGOXRTQlNnQVRScklzNU5QdjVmV2YzOWlFVWZXMXFSZWxscFJIdFY0UHhleHZreWhkRmhqNGpCeTBYTVlpZ3AxcFN5X0h6SkFqSHJzSTBhWER6N1lkQXB3cnlLRXU4TF95ZjNWdC01XzBkTm0zOGN3RmpXc1lQSkdR?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a></span></li>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Market Sentiment and Commodities:</strong> Indian markets are expected to see a flat opening as positive global sentiment—driven by softer US inflation and strong bank earnings—offsets the impact of crude oil prices surging above $85 per barrel.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigwFBVV95cUxPdWRaMVFPRFNSMDhQQ1dQT09aWlhsdzdhVGVFcGUzblZreE9kSms3eXc3ZjRlbVhvdUtFRW5IQ3ZSSE42bnhoTGxIaVlwbVVQR0tLUE0yY1N3NTJ2Qko2S01pNHREcW5CbmpweXpORmVRRzdCR0RDcTRjeG9oS2tqR2hIWQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Currency and Regional Performance:</strong> The rupee has weakened to a one-month low past the 96-level, while Asian markets like the Kospi and Nikkei are rallying up to 6% following cooling US inflation data.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a></span></li>
